name: Nebo Video
description: Probe, trim, and assemble videos from a declarative project JSON. ffmpeg is built in — nothing to install.
author: NeboAI

tools.name: video.probe
tools.description: Return metadata (duration, dimensions, fps, codecs, streams) for a media file. Call this before any editing to know what you're working with.

input.description: Absolute path to the media file

tools.name: video.trim
tools.description: Cut [start..end] from a media file into a new output. Fast when the input has keyframes near the cut points (uses stream copy); otherwise re-encodes.

input.description: Absolute path to the source media file

output.description: Absolute path to write the trimmed MP4

reencode.description: Force a full re-encode (slower, frame-accurate). Defaults to stream copy when safe.

tools.name: video.render
tools.description: Assemble a full video from a declarative project JSON. The project describes the output format and a sequence of video, audio, and text tracks with clip timings. Produces a single H.264/AAC MP4.

project.description: Absolute path to a project.json file. See the plugin docs for the schema; the minimum is {output:{width,height,fps},tracks:[{type:'video',clips:[{source,start,duration,trim_start?}]}]}.

output.description: Absolute path to write the rendered MP4
